test_Upsample2D: test the Upsample2D class to verify it doubles spatial dimensions of input tensors
test_Downsample2D: test the Downsample2D class to verify it halves spatial dimensions of input tensors
test_Downsample2D_asymmetric_padding: test the Downsample2D class with asymmetric padding enabled to verify correct output values
run_test_upsample: run the test_upsample pytest to validate Upsample2D upsampling produces expected tensor sum
run_test_downsample: run the TestDownsample parametrized tests to validate Downsample2D with both padding modes
